info.title: EDMN Customer App API
info.description: Customer App (buyers and sellers). Arabic is the default language; error `code` values are stable and are what the app localizes. Money is integer piastres. Real Money is OFF: payments are labelled TEST.

get.summary: App bootstrap: minimum supported versions, locales, feature availability

post.summary: Sign in with email or phone and password
Sign out this device
Request a password-reset link (always answers the same, whether or not the account exists)
Set a new password with the token from the reset link (every session is signed out)
Create a customer account and sign this device in
Rotate the refresh token (single use) and get a new access token
post.description: Presenting an already-used refresh token, or a refresh token from another installation, revokes the session.

installationId.description: Random per-installation id generated by the app and kept in secure storage.

post.description: Phone codes need an SMS provider; when none can deliver, the request is refused instead of pretending a code was sent.

post.summary: Place the order for my cart (one order, one sub-order per seller)
post.description: checkoutKey is the idempotency key of THIS checkout: retrying with the same key returns the same order. expectedTotal / expectedPricingVersionId are the values the buyer saw; if the server now computes something else the order is refused (conflict) and the app must show the new quote.

created.description: false = this checkoutKey already produced this order (retry)

get.summary: My store's funds position — read only (finance.view)
get.description: Holds, booked debt and uncovered claims are reported separately and are never withdrawable; withdrawablePiastres = available − held (never negative). Payout requests stay on the web Seller Center (Maker/Checker on the EDMN side).
